segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: OK, well, good morning everybody!

segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: My name's Elizabeth Reed and I'm your Assistant Welfare Officer.

segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: What I'd like to do now is tell you a little more about some of the er . . . the social facilities available on the campus, and also to tell you something about what the town has to offer.

segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: As you probably know already, the Student Union Building is the main centre of social life here, as indeed it is in most British Universities.

segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: The Union runs a weekly programme of events for all tastes . . . oh everything from discos to talks by guest speakers.

segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: Many of these events are fund raising activities for charities, which the Union takes very seriously.

segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: They manage the Students' Union papershop, selling magazines and newspapers, as well as stationery, sweets and so on.

segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: Um . . .

segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: Then . . . er, let me see... there's the Ticket Shop, where you can get some very good deals on, well for , coaches to London or inexpensive charter flights, as cheap as you'll get anywhere people say, or tickets for big pop groups playing here or at other venues all over the country, or plays in London - oh and we mustn't forget the Union Cafeteria and the Big New Diner...

segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: Er . . . yes?

segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: Did you have a question?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Yes, does the Union also provide help with any problems, I mean advice on financial problems, for ?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Or does the University provide that?

segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: Yes, the Union run their own advice service, offering help with financial matters such as grants.

segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: I am sure you realise anything medical should be discussed with the University Medical Service, which also has an excellent counselling centre.

segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: I think that was made clear yesterday.

segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: However the Union has its own officer who can give advice on legal problems.

segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: Now, onto Radford.

segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: For a town of its size, Radford has some unusually good leisure and community facilities and has quite a good shopping centre, with an interesting range of shops.

segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: As you go into Radford, there's a new . . . well, quite new .. .

segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: Olympic-size swimming pool.

segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: That's on the outskirts at a place called Renton.

segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: Above the pool there's a hi-tech fitness centre.

segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: Are there any ice skaters here?

segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: No?

segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: Oh, pity!

segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: The facilities for ice-skating are excellent.

segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: Well, the new Metro Tower, right in the centre of town has got an ice rink and a sports hall for squash, badminton, volleyball and several other indoor sports.

segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: And in the same building there's a new cinema with six screens.

segments.speaker: ELIZABETH
segments.en: Er . . . then, let me see, in the main square, just two minutes' walk from the Metro Tower, there's the Theatre Royal, which often gets London productions on tour... and in the streets nearby you can find a good range of inexpensive restaurants including Indian, Chinese, Thai and . . .
